entities.name: B2HNT8
observations: Reviewed Mycobacterium marinum RNase P protein component; query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match (120 aa, 100% identity and coverage; E=7.47e-79).
UniProt annotation: binds the pre-tRNA 5′ leader and supports RNase P ribozyme substrate recognition; RNase P removes the 5′ leader from pre-tRNA.
Sequence-derived: 120 aa, 13,556.57 Da, predicted pI 11.843, estimated charge at pH 7 +13.93.

entities.name: RNase P complex
observations: The referenced RNase P protein component is annotated as associating with catalytic RNase P RNA in the RNase P complex.
